text:
maria: Heads-up: scheduling a bulk redirect/rotation for KB anchors tomorrow 09:00 PT. We'll replace legacy /runtime-guide/* anchors with canonical /runtime/* and add 302s. Owners please review the list: /kb/runtime, /kb/models, /kb/deploy. I'm going to open quick PRs for low-effort fixes.

ben: Thanks — can you paste the list? I can run a sweep script.

maria: list:
- /kb/runtime/guide#prefetch
- /kb/models/quantization#faq
- /kb/deploy/volume-mounts#troubleshoot

lucy: I'll take /kb/models/quantization#faq.

alex: For relative->absolute link fixes, this sed worked for me in a PR branch:
```
# convert ../path/#anchor to /kb/path/#anchor
git grep -l '\.\./.*#' docs/ | xargs -n1 sed -i 's#\.\./\([^#]*\)\(#/kb/\1\(#g'
```
Tested locally, no binary files touched.

sasha: @maria are we rolling the 302s first or code-first? Need to decide for external refs.

maria: plan: code-first small fixes + canary redirect -> full redirect. Rollback via nginx config if anything flaps.

deploy-bot: deploy started: site/docs at sha abc123 -> staging

ben: I'll open PRs for runtime + deploy patches today. tagging owners in PRs.

docs-bot: ping @owners: please review PRs within 24h or comment to opt out :bell:

lucy: PR opened: #5423 — assigning to me and @maria. quick review please.

maria: ACK, will review before EOD.

alex: small nit: check anchors with hyphens, sed above misses them, use '\-' in regex.

ben: added test script to CI to fail on broken anchors: `scripts/check-anchors.sh` — runs against build.

sasha: thanks all. if owners can't review ping me and I'll triage. :thumbsup:

maria: closing loop: site deploy succeeded on staging, will schedule prod ~09:15 PT tomorrow after final approvals. :party:
